title: Whose Name Comes Up? Auditing LLM-Based Scholar Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring the perceived gender of recommended scholars from their names using the gender-guesser tool and comparing the resulting male/female/neutral distribution against the baseline gender distribution in the American Physical Society (APS) dataset.

Inferring the perceived ethnicity of recommended scholars from their names using demographicx and ethnicolr tools, and comparing the representation of groups (Asian, White, Latino, Black) against the APS dataset baseline.

Analyzing the scholarly metrics (publication counts, citation counts, h-index, career age, and Nobel laureate status) of recommended scholars and comparing their percentiles against the general academic population to identify preferences for established or famous researchers.

Measuring the diversity of recommended scholars by calculating pairwise Jaccard and cosine similarities based on country of affiliation, institutional affiliation, co-authorship networks, and scholarly metric embeddings (via PCA).
